Question: A and B are two events. If P(A, B) decreases while P(A) increases, which of the following is true?

Options: 
A. P(A or B) increases
B. P(A|B) decreases
C. None of the above
D. P(A|B) increases
E. P(B) decreases
F. P(B|A) decreases
G. P(B|A) increases
H. All of above

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
